headline: AMP Q2 Deep Dive: Asset Growth, Adviser Productivity, and Strategic Platform Expansion
summary: Financial services company Ameriprise Financial (NYSE:AMP) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 13% year on year to $4.90 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $11.07 per share was 2.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
